code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 2}
    groups = []
    for color in colors:
        pts = sorted((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == color)
        if len(pts) < 2: continue
        (r1,c1),(r2,c2) = pts[:2]
        dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
        dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
        groups.append(( (r1+r2)/2, color, (r1,c1), (r2,c2), dr, dc))
    groups.sort()
    n = len(groups)
    for i, (_,color,p1,p2,dr,dc) in enumerate(groups):
        if i < n//2:
            r,c = p1
            dr,dc = -dr,-dc
        else:
            r,c = p2
        while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
            if out[r][c] == 2 or out[r][c] == color: out[r][c] = color
            r += dr; c += dc
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code); exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec')); ans=transform(grid); print(ans)
